title: digitaria sanguinalis var. horizontalis
intro: Digitaria sanguinalis var. horizontalis, commonly known as Ditch Grass or Crab Grass, is a type of grassy plant that belongs to the Poaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly in treating various health issues. The health benefits of Digitaria sanguinalis var. horizontalis include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of fever, diarrhea, and respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as analgesic, anti-edematous, and hepatoprotective effects.
